I feel confident when I know that I prepare well and put real effort into something. When I see myself improving step by step, it gives me a strong sense of control.

Support from the people around me also helps; hearing positive feedback or knowing someone believes in me makes a big difference.

Confidence also comes from past experiences. When I remember challenges I have already overcome, I feel more capable of facing new ones.

Overall, confidence grows when I trust myself and stay consistent.
